A '''Sienar Observation Module''' was a five story [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] control tower that was manufactured by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]]. The [[Spaceport Traffic Control/Legends|Mos Eisley Spaceport Control Tower]] was a Sienar Observation Module.
